teaser.en: A single jackfruit can outweigh a small child, and it grows straight out of the trunk rather than from the branches.
teaser.sw: Fenesi moja linaweza kuwa zito kuliko mtoto mdogo, na huota moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina badala ya matawi.
teaser.dg: Fenesi rimwenga rinaweza kukala rizito kuriko mwana mdide, na rinamera kula kpwa kolo moja kpwa moja, si kula kpwa panda.

summary.en: The *mfenesi* is the jackfruit tree, a big shade tree of coastal homesteads that carries the largest fruit of any tree. Its sweet pulp, starchy seeds and cookable green fruit have long helped Digo households through the hungry months.
summary.sw: *Mfenesi* ni mti mkubwa wa kivuli katika maboma ya pwani unaobeba tunda kubwa kuliko la mti mwingine wowote. Nyama yake tamu, mbegu zake zenye wanga na tunda bichi linaloweza kupikwa vimesaidia kaya za Wadigo kwa muda mrefu kuvuka miezi ya njaa.
summary.dg: *Mfenesi* ni muhi wa fenesi, muhi mkulu wa pepho wa midzi ya pwani unaotsukula tunda kulu kuriko muhi wowosi. Nyamaye ya mtswano, tembeze zenye wanga na tundare ra chijani rinarojitwa vikaterya mbari za Adigo kpwa muda mrefu kutsupa miezi ya ndzala.

about.en:
*Mfenesi* is a large evergreen tree with a dense, dark crown and thick, glossy, leathery leaves. Cut any part of it and it bleeds a sticky white latex, a trait it shares with its fig and breadfruit relatives in the family Moraceae.

The fruit is what stops people in their tracks. It hangs on short stalks straight from the trunk and the thickest branches, and it can grow to the size of a sack of grain. The skin is green to yellowish and covered in blunt knobs. Inside, dozens of golden, fleshy bulbs each wrap a smooth seed, and a ripe fruit fills the yard with a heavy, sweet smell.
about.sw:
*Mfenesi* ni mti mkubwa wenye majani mwaka mzima, taji nene la kijani kilichokolea na majani mazito, yanayong'aa na magumu kama ngozi. Ukikata sehemu yoyote yake hutoa utomvu mweupe unaonata, sifa inayoshirikiana na jamaa zake mitini na mshelisheli katika familia ya Moraceae.

Tunda ndilo linalowashangaza watu. Huning'inia kwenye vikonyo vifupi moja kwa moja kutoka shina na matawi manene zaidi, na linaweza kukua hadi kufikia ukubwa wa gunia la nafaka. Ngozi yake ni ya kijani hadi manjano hafifu na imefunikwa na vinundu butu. Ndani, makumi ya vipande vya nyama vya rangi ya dhahabu kila kimoja kimefunika mbegu laini, na tunda lililoiva hujaza uwanja harufu nzito tamu.
about.dg:
*Mfenesi* ni muhi mkulu wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye chitswa chizito cha rangi chiru na makodza manene ganagong'ala na mafu dza chingo. Uchikata seemu yoyosi ya muhi, inalavya maziya nyereru ganagonyata, tabiya ambayo inafwanana na ndugue a mkuyu na mfenesi-bata kpwa jamii ya Moraceae.

Tunda ndiro rinaroima atu na kulola. Rinabwadzika kpwa milita mifupi kula kpwa kolo moja kpwa moja na kpwa panda kulu zaidi, na rinaweza kukula hadi kufika ukulu wa gunia ra nafaka. Gada ra kondze ni ra chijani hadi rangi ya mandano chidide na rina vinundu. Ndani, kuna vipande dazeni za nyama ya rangi ya dhahabu, chila chimwenga chinazunguluka tembe laini, na fenesi ririroivwa rinadzaza mhala harufu nzito ya mtswano.

where.en: Look for *mfenesi* around homesteads, where it is kept as a shade tree as much as for its fruit. It is a planted tree rather than a wild one, so it turns up near houses, compounds and small farms along the south coast rather than in the bush or forest.
where.sw: Tafuta *mfenesi* kuzunguka maboma, ambako huhifadhiwa kama mti wa kivuli sawa na kwa ajili ya matunda yake. Ni mti wa kupandwa wala si wa porini, kwa hivyo hupatikana karibu na nyumba, nyua na mashamba madogo katika pwani ya kusini badala ya vichakani au msituni.
where.dg: Hendza *mfenesi* kanda-kanda ya midzi, ambapho nkurindwa dza muhi wa pepho dza vira unavyorindwa kpwa matundage. Ni muhi wa kuphandwa, si wa weruni, kpwa hivyo unaonekana phephi na nyumba, mihala na minda midide kanda-kanda ya pwani ya kusini, si weruni wala tsakani.

uses.en:
The ripe pulp is eaten fresh. The seeds are not wasted: they are boiled or roasted and eaten like nuts, and unripe fruit is cooked as a vegetable. Because one tree can give so much starchy food, jackfruit is an important standby in the hungry season before the next harvest.

The timber is also valued and is used for making doors.
uses.sw:
Nyama iliyoiva huliwa mbichi. Mbegu hazipotei bure: huchemshwa au kubanikwa na kuliwa kama karanga, na tunda bichi hupikwa kama mboga. Kwa kuwa mti mmoja unaweza kutoa chakula kingi chenye wanga, fenesi ni akiba muhimu wakati wa msimu wa njaa kabla ya mavuno yanayofuata.

Mbao zake pia zinathaminiwa na hutumika kutengeneza milango.
uses.dg:
Nyama ya fenesi ririroivwa nkuriwa dza irivyo. Tembe tazitsuphwa: nkutserusiwa au nkuochwa na kuriwa dza njugu, na fenesi risiroivwa nkujitwa dza mtsunga. Kpwa sababu muhi mmwenga unaweza kulavya chakurya chinji cha wanga, fenesi ni chakurya cha muhimu cha kuikirwa wakati wa ndzala kabla ya mavuno ganagolunga.

Mbaoze piya zina samani na nkuhumirwa kuhenda maluvwi.

names.en: In Digo the tree is *mfenesi*, the same word as in Swahili, where the fruit is called *fenesi*. Giriama also uses *mfenesi*. In English it is jackfruit.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo mti ni *mfenesi*, neno lilelile la Kiswahili, ambapo tunda huitwa *fenesi*. Kigiriama pia hutumia *mfenesi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *jackfruit*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo muhi ni *mfenesi*, neno ra sawa na Chiswahili, ambapho tunda rinaihwa *fenesi*. Chigiryama piya chinahumira *mfenesi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *jackfruit*.

reason.en: Same genus, Artocarpus; another starchy homestead fruit
reason.sw: Jenasi moja, Artocarpus; tunda jingine la bomani lenye wanga
reason.dg: Wa jenasi mwenga, Artocarpus; tunda ranjina ra wanga ra midzi

reason.en: Fellow homestead shade and fruit tree
reason.sw: Mti mwenzake wa kivuli na matunda wa bomani
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa pepho na matunda wa midzi

reason.en: A wild relative in the fig family, with the same milky latex
reason.sw: Jamaa wa porini katika familia ya mitini, mwenye utomvu mweupe uleule
reason.dg: Ndugu wa weruni wa jamii ya mkuyu, wenye maziya dza gaga

reason.en: Another fruit cooked green and eaten ripe
reason.sw: Tunda jingine linalopikwa likiwa bichi na kuliwa likiwa limeiva
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina rinarojitwa richiri ra chijani na kuriwa ririchoivwa
